Chapter 6707: True Dragon’S Gift

Chapter 6707: True Dragon’s Gift

“Temporal Unaffected.” The duo waved and repelled the destructive wave effortlessly.

“Pop!” However, the wave spiraled back a moment later, leaving everyone confused.

“Defiant Howl!” Li Qiye roared again and the moon behind him collapsed.

Meanwhile, the returning wave pulled both immortals toward the collapsing moon. The swirling suction dried up everything, sealing both immortals.

Time and space collapsed around their body, forming a terrible siphon. Three Immortals were being pulled there as well.

“Temporal Nullification.” Unfortunately, this didn’t do much against them.

Their body resembled the high heaven and was the lord of time and space. They could create infinite time and space with a single wave so this was just child’s play.

“Our turn. Judgment for the wicked!” They approached, shouting.

“Crackle.” A tribulation descended. This time, it didn’t only have an ocean of lightning but also a physical firmament.

“Rise!” Li Qiye’s body vibrated before crouching down like a turtle.

He flashed with a strange radiance, seemingly from the nine layers of hell: “Burdened turtle, Heaven Raiser!”

Heaven Raiser was the gift of the burdened turtles. Once activated, nine hills rose with nine nether worlds beneath them.

The hills reached heaven while the nine nether worlds raised the ocean of lightning upward.

“The heaven can’t be shouldered!” The two immortals shouted.

Not even ten thousand immortals could stop the might of the high heaven. Therefore, the turtle exploded, revealing Li Qiye.

“Bam!” He smashed against the wall of the primordial battlefield, leaving visible damage.

“Who can stop the high heaven...” Supreme Black Ancestor murmured. This was Li Qiye’s first time being sent flying.

“The divine gifts are no match for us!” The two immortals shouted.

“That depends on the divine beast.” Li Qiye smiled and leaped into the air.

“True dragon!” He soared freely despite the pressure from the tribulation.

“Extermination!” The two immortals declared and severed the river of time. Worlds fell chaotically to everyone’s horror.

“Slaughter!” Li Qiye soared above the high heaven - a height unreachable by anyone else.

Everything stopped, whether it be the extermination or the falling worlds.

The gift of the true dragon easily lifted the falling tribulation and firmament while slamming the two immortals.

They vomited blood and shocked the crowd. It appeared that injuring the high heaven body was possible.

“How can this be? This gift...” Both staggered backward.

“You could say this is an awakened hidden gift.” Li Qiye smiled: “Among all living beings, the divine beasts aren’t necessarily inferior to the primordials. The true dragons, in particular, have the potential to break the limit of gifts.”

“A gift capable of contending against the high heaven.” The duo exchanged glances.

“If your kind can fight the high heaven, so can they.” Li Qiye said: “It’s just that the world knows so little of them now.”

“I believe this would be a different story if this shored body is complete.” Evil Transformation said.

“Go for it.” Li Qiye said.

“Fusion!” The two exchanged glances and clasped their fingers together.

“Crackle!” Lightning bolts surged around them as they melted into one being.

The world turned dark; only an apocalyptic light could be seen above. The world couldn’t endure the fused body’s presence.
